title: Laurus Labs falls 4.6% after promoter sales

timeline.title: Laurus Labs falls 4.6% after promoter sales
timeline.line: Two promoter entities sold about 19.6 lakh shares on November 11, filings show
more: The stock was at ₹2,311.70 at 11:37, down from ₹2,424
Business Upturn says the filing alone does not establish the cause of the fall

src.title: Laurus Labs promoters sell about 19.6 lakh shares; stock falls 4.6% to ₹2,311 on Monday
